mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_review (product_id, order_item_id, user_id, rating, content, images, tags, parent_id, is_additional, is_anonymous) VALUES (#{productId}, #{orderItemId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{images}, #{tags}, #{parentId}, #{isAdditional}, #{isAnonymous})
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND parent_id IS NULL AND status = 1 AND rating >= 4 AND rating = 3 AND rating <= 2 AND images IS NOT NULL AND images != '' ORDER BY
rating DESC, created_at DESC rating ASC, created_at DESC CASE WHEN images IS NOT NULL AND images != '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at DESC created_at DESC
SELECT FROM product_review WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS count FROM product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1 GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating DESC
